name: Martesian Forest Guardian (CR 1/2)
body:
MARTESIAN FOREST GUARDIAN
CR 1/2

This humanoid has leathery, earth-colored skin and a long snaky neck that bends forward and then up, ending in a small domed head with two eyes on top. A wide mouth opens on either side of their neck, producing stereo sound when they speak.

XP 200
Martesian druid 1
NG Medium humanoid (martesian)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 10, flat-footed 14 (+2 armor, +2 shield)
hp 10 (1d8+1+1)
Fort +3, Ref +0, Will +5
Resist sonic 5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee scimitar +3 (1d6+4 S, 18-20/x2; sweep)
Ranged sling +0 (1d4+3 B, range incr. 50 ft.)
Special Attacks bellow (1/hour, 15-ft. cone, 2d4 sonic, DC 11 Reflex half), resonance

Domain Spell-Like Abilities (CL 1st; concentration +4)

6/day—acid dart

Druid Spells Prepared (CL 1st; concentration +4)

0-level (at will)—know direction, light, stabilize
1st-level—cure light wounds, entangle (DC 14), magic stone

Domain Earth; domain spells

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 10, Con 13, Int 10, Wis 17, Cha 8
Base Atk +0; CMB +3; CMD 13
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Knowledge (nature) +8, Perception +7, Spellcraft +4, Survival +11; Species Modifiers +2 Knowledge (nature), +2 Survival
Languages Common, Martesian
SQ hold breath (52 rounds), nature bond (domain), spontaneous casting (summon nature’s ally spells), wild empathy +0
Gear NPC gear (leather armor, heavy wooden shield, scimitar, sling with 10 bullets, other gear)

ABOUT

Martesians have a strong connection to their forest home—and martesian guardians are not shy about defending it.
